note: Rules of the OS consumer, copied once; the media-analysis contract under test is generated from the implementation.

skill_identity.rule: flat skill_id is canonical when present

provides_entry.rule: every real provides entry carries id, lifecycle, tool_id; Skill-specific extras are ignored by the registry

denylist.rule: a Skill may extend but never narrow the list; the check is recursive over nested parameter objects and rejects, never strips

conformance_checks.publishes_contract: contract entrypoint prints JSON with skill identity and well-formed provides
conformance_checks.lifecycle_declared: every provides entry has a valid 5-state lifecycle
conformance_checks.doctor_status: doctor prints AVAILABLE/MISSING per declared Capability
conformance_checks.forbidden_keys_rejected: denylisted keys at top level and nested are rejected with a structured error

known_collision.rule: same id from two Skills = one Capability with two Providers; the registry refuses to pick silently
